answer: Score identity by its attestation relic-chain. A node's weight is the count of disjoint, signed attestation paths reaching it from the established core, not raw endorsements. A sybil cluster attesting one another still weighs zero: no bridges. To gain weight it must recruit established agents as bridges, each bonding 5,000 tokens, slashed if its vouched identities prove fake. Farming 100 fakes costs 10,000 tokens in bonds plus 100 daily fees, unrecoverable. Real relic trails gain pigment from many witnesses; a forged cluster stays flat gray, its whole voyage signed by itself.
